title: Shared course workflows and tutor architecture v2 refactor
goal: Evolve the repository-backed course tutoring/application architecture to the task-capsule-driven workspace-control v2 model: remove dependence on conversational builder/tutor hierarchy, define reusable course and document-artifact workflow descriptors/procedures, improve assessment alignment and multimodal ingestion, preserve project-local authority and mastery semantics, and create independently executable migration capsules for MTH602, CIS560, EAS501, and the resume/application workflow.
acceptance_criteria: The shared architecture treats conversations as replaceable executors while durable semantic owners, reusable workflow/procedure definitions, exact task state, and mutation boundaries remain authoritative.

Task-capsule v2 retains its single optional workflow binding; conceptual composition is represented by one composite workflow descriptor plus stage/procedure routing, not by silently changing v2 schema.

Shared-contract changes do not silently migrate active tasks, and archived capsules remain immutable historical execution evidence. Any active task adopting a newer shared contract uses an explicit validated workflow-version transition.

Assessment preparation distinguishes course/factual authority from assessment-relevance evidence without imposing a universal hard ranking among old exams, practice sets, lecture examples, or review material.

Handwritten/whiteboard ingestion defaults to direct multimodal interpretation when effective; original images remain source evidence, synthesis remains derived, and uncertainty stays explicit. OCR/Mathpix is optional and modality-appropriate.

Reusable document-artifact workflow supports LaTeX homework and cheat-sheet production through source, deterministic build, structural validation, rendered visual QA, bounded revision, and delivery/submission gates. Automated visual QA is sufficient unless the owning workflow explicitly requires human judgment.

New course workflows inherit the current operator continuation obligation and workspace scratch rules; executors continue while safe authorized work remains and suspend only at a demonstrated capability, irreducible-input, authority/safety, or required-human-judgment boundary.
Every material JSON task-capsule mutation is immediately followed by deterministic task-render Markdown regeneration before further task operations or handoff.
CIS560-AdamTrott and EAS501-AdamTrott are added to repos.json using stable repository identity only; volatile task branch/HEAD/runtime facts remain outside the registry.
MTH602, CIS560, EAS501, PADataset research, and future resume/application domains retain their own project truth; workspace-control owns only generic reusable operating/tutoring/artifact mechanics.

Legacy builder/tutor role dependencies are removed from project integrations only where they exist; shared workspace-control is not rewritten merely to delete a conversational role it already does not require.

Resume/application separation from PADataset is evaluated explicitly rather than performed automatically; any move to a dedicated private domain repository requires its own justified migration decision.
The completed PADataset integration capsule remains unchanged, and the active automated-research-engine task is not silently migrated by this task.

After shared validation, separate durable migration capsules are created for MTH602, CIS560, EAS501, and resume/application integration, each with exact project checkpoints and a first safe action suitable for a fresh executor.
constraints: Start from workspace-control README.md and current v2 contracts; do not recursively inventory project repositories.

It is recorded as a required checkpoint rather than the capsule workflow field because this task mutates workspace-control itself; do not create a self-referential workflow-binding defect.
Do not change task-capsule v2 to support multiple workflow bindings. Any future structural expansion requires a separately versioned, compatibility-preserving schema task.

Do not silently migrate existing active or archived task capsules when shared contracts change. Preserve exact workflow bindings. Active tasks may adopt a new shared-contract checkpoint only through an explicit validated workflow-version transition; archived tasks remain immutable.
Do not modify tasks/archive/padataset-control-plane-v2-integration.json or its derived Markdown.

Do not modify automated-research-engine-v1 task state as part of this architecture task. When that task resumes, its older OPERATOR_WORKFLOW pin must be migrated explicitly and validated within that task before newer semantics are relied upon.
Do not mutate MTH602, CIS560, EAS501, or PADataset project content during this shared architecture task. Project migrations belong to separate child capsules after the shared design is validated.
Before CIS560 or EAS501 can be formal repository entries in this capsule, register their stable identities in repos.json. Do not weaken validation to bypass this bootstrap.

Assessment relevance must be represented as contextual evidence weighting using factors such as recency, instructor specificity, explicit assessment guidance, demonstrated problem-form correspondence, and source role; do not hardcode prior exam > practice globally.
Original classroom/handwritten images remain source evidence even when direct multimodal synthesis is preferred; derived synthesis must preserve provenance and uncertainty.
Visual QA is an artifact-validation operation, not automatically a human gate. Require Adam only when the owning workflow explicitly makes human judgment/approval necessary.
Professor-email ingestion should model forwarded Gmail as an available source adapter when school Outlook is inaccessible; do not engineer pseudo-real-time Outlook connectivity.
Shared artifact mechanics may be generalized upward, but candidate/course/application truth must remain with its domain owner.
Use direct GitHub tooling for remotely provable work. Introduce local/runtime execution only when actual build/render/test evidence requires it.
If mutation scope must expand beyond the recorded workspace-control paths, update the capsule and regenerate its Markdown before performing the expanded mutation.
